description: Repo-scale (ruby-eventboard): RsvpService#bulk_transfer_waitlist must validate every rsvp is currently waitlisted BEFORE moving any of them (atomic across two events), plus a destination waitlist_capacity check
prompts: Events gain an optional `waitlist_capacity` (a non-negative integer, or nil meaning unlimited) - accept it as a keyword arg in `EventRepository#create`. Add `RsvpService#bulk_transfer_waitlist(rsvp_ids:, to_event_id:)`, moving a batch of currently-waitlisted rsvps to a different event's waitlist. This must be atomic in two ways: (1) validate that EVERY rsvp_id in the request exists and is currently "waitlisted" BEFORE moving any of them - if one isn't, raise RsvpError and leave every rsvp exactly where it was, not partially transferred; (2) validate that moving the WHOLE batch into the destination event wouldn't push its waitlisted count over its waitlist_capacity, again before moving anything. Return the array of moved rsvps.

test_setup_files.test/bulk_transfer_waitlist_test.rb:
require_relative "test_helper"

class BulkTransferWaitlistTest < Minitest::Test
  include EventBoardTestSetup

  def test_transfer_is_atomic_on_non_waitlisted_rsvp
    events, attendees, rsvps, service = build_service
    from_event = events.create(title: "A", capacity: 1)
    to_event = events.create(title: "B", capacity: 5)
    a1 = attendees.create(name: "A", email: "a@example.com")
    a2 = attendees.create(name: "B", email: "b@example.com")

    confirmed = service.register(event_id: from_event.id, attendee_id: a1.id)
    waitlisted = service.register(event_id: from_event.id, attendee_id: a2.id)
    assert_equal "confirmed", confirmed.status
    assert_equal "waitlisted", waitlisted.status

    assert_raises(EventBoard::RsvpError) do
      service.bulk_transfer_waitlist(rsvp_ids: [waitlisted.id, confirmed.id], to_event_id: to_event.id)
    end

    assert_equal from_event.id, rsvps.find(waitlisted.id).event_id
  end

  def test_transfer_respects_destination_waitlist_capacity
    events, attendees, rsvps, service = build_service
    from_event = events.create(title: "A", capacity: 0)
    to_event = events.create(title: "B", capacity: 0, waitlist_capacity: 1)
    a1 = attendees.create(name: "A", email: "a@example.com")
    a2 = attendees.create(name: "B", email: "b@example.com")

    r1 = service.register(event_id: from_event.id, attendee_id: a1.id)
    r2 = service.register(event_id: from_event.id, attendee_id: a2.id)

    assert_raises(EventBoard::RsvpError) do
      service.bulk_transfer_waitlist(rsvp_ids: [r1.id, r2.id], to_event_id: to_event.id)
    end
  end
end

module EventBoard
  class RsvpError < StandardError; end

  class RsvpService
    def initialize(events:, attendees:, rsvps:)
      @events = events
      @attendees = attendees
      @rsvps = rsvps
    end

    def register(event_id:, attendee_id:)
      event = @events.find(event_id)
      raise RsvpError, "event not found" unless event
      raise RsvpError, "attendee not found" unless @attendees.find(attendee_id)

      status = confirmed_count(event_id) < event.capacity ? "confirmed" : "waitlisted"
      @rsvps.create(event_id: event_id, attendee_id: attendee_id, status: status, created_at: Time.now.to_f)
    end

    # Moves a batch of currently-waitlisted rsvps to a different event's
    # waitlist. Must be atomic in two ways: (1) validate every rsvp_id
    # exists and is currently "waitlisted" BEFORE moving any of them -
    # one bad id anywhere in the list leaves every rsvp exactly where it
    # was; (2) validate the WHOLE batch's combined size against the
    # destination event's waitlist_capacity (existing waitlisted count +
    # batch size), again before moving anything.
    def bulk_transfer_waitlist(rsvp_ids:, to_event_id:)
      to_event = @events.find(to_event_id)
      raise RsvpError, "destination event not found" unless to_event
      raise RsvpError, "rsvp_ids must not be empty" if rsvp_ids.empty?

      targets = rsvp_ids.map do |rsvp_id|
        rsvp = @rsvps.find(rsvp_id)
        raise RsvpError, "rsvp not found" unless rsvp
        raise RsvpError, "rsvp #{rsvp_id} is not waitlisted" unless rsvp.status == "waitlisted"
        rsvp
      end

      if to_event.waitlist_capacity
        current = waitlisted_count(to_event_id)
        if current + targets.size > to_event.waitlist_capacity
          raise RsvpError, "destination event's waitlist is already full"
        end
      end

      targets.each { |rsvp| rsvp.event_id = to_event_id }
      targets
    end

    def cancel(rsvp_id)
      rsvp = @rsvps.find(rsvp_id)
      raise RsvpError, "rsvp not found" unless rsvp
      raise RsvpError, "rsvp already canceled" if rsvp.status == "canceled"

      was_confirmed = rsvp.status == "confirmed"
      rsvp.status = "canceled"

      if was_confirmed
        next_waiting = @rsvps.for_event(rsvp.event_id).select { |r| r.status == "waitlisted" }.min_by(&:id)
        next_waiting.status = "confirmed" if next_waiting
      end

      rsvp
    end

    private

    def confirmed_count(event_id)
      @rsvps.for_event(event_id).count { |r| r.status == "confirmed" }
    end

    def waitlisted_count(event_id)
      @rsvps.for_event(event_id).count { |r| r.status == "waitlisted" }
    end
  end
end
